title: GSK delivers strong Q2 2026 core results and continued momentum

title: Q2 2026 segment performance: Specialty and Vaccines drive growth, General Medicines declines
evidence: Specialty Medicines £3.8bn (+14%); Vaccines £2.3bn (+8%); General Medicines £2.3bn (-9%)

title: GSK narrows 2026 guidance toward upper half of ranges after Q2
evidence: 2026 guidance: turnover growth 3-5%; core operating profit +7-9%; core EPS +7-9%; FY dividend expected 70p

title: GSK delivers strong 2025 performance and re-affirms long-term outlooks
evidence: FY2025 turnover £32.7bn (+4% AER, +7% CER); core operating profit £9.783bn; core EPS 172.0p (+8% AER)

title: GSK FY2025: CEO cites double-digit Specialty Medicines growth
evidence: Luke Miels: driven mainly by Specialty Medicines, with double-digit sales growth in Respiratory, Immunology & Inflammation, Oncology and HIV

title: GSK delivers strong Q1 performance and start to 2026
evidence: Q1 2026 sales £7.6bn (+2% AER, +5% CER); Specialty Medicines £3.2bn (+14%); core operating profit +10%

title: Shingrix sets record quarter with over £1bn sales in Q1 2026
evidence: Shingrix delivered more than £1.0bn, up 20%, a record for quarterly sales; HIV sales £1.8bn (+10%)

title: GSK announces early-stage acquisitions of ozureprubart and HS235 in Q1 2026
evidence: Two acquisitions announced: ozureprubart in food allergies and HS235 in pulmonary hypertension, both with clinically validated MOAs

title: General Medicines decline reflects competition/genericization of older portfolio
evidence: General Medicines down 6% in Q1, driven by declining sales of the older established portfolio

title: GSK targets £1.9bn annual savings by 2029 to fund late-stage pipeline
evidence: £1.9 billion annual savings targeted by 2029 to fund late-stage portfolio investment

title: GSK plans 20+ phase III trial starts in 2026 under Accelerate Growth strategy
evidence: Expect 20+ phase III trial starts in 2026 (up from 10); 7 asset accelerations identified across 18 indications

title: GSK on track for 2031 sales outlook of more than £40 billion
evidence: On track for 2031 sales outlook of more than £40 billion; Accelerating growth from 2031 onwards

title: GSK completes $10.6 billion acquisition of Nuvalent, expanding lung cancer pipeline
evidence: Aggregate equity value approximately $10.6 billion (£8.0 billion); adds zidesamtinib, neladalkib and NVL-330 for NSCLC

title: Blenrep approved by US FDA for relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma
evidence: FDA approved Blenrep (belantamab mafodotin-blmf) with bortezomib and dexamethasone; DREAMM-7 showed 51% reduction in risk of death

title: Nucala (mepolizumab) approved by US FDA for COPD with eosinophilic phenotype
evidence: Only approved biologic studied in a wide COPD population with eosinophilic phenotype from blood eosinophil count 150 cells/uL

title: Arexvy approved by US FDA for expanded age indication in adults 18-49 at increased risk
evidence: FDA expanded the approved age indication of Arexvy to adults aged 18 to 49 years at increased risk for RSV lower respiratory tract disease

title: Penmenvy 5-in-1 meningococcal vaccine approved by US FDA against MenABCWY
evidence: FDA approved Penmenvy (Meningococcal Groups A, B, C, W, and Y Vaccine) for use in individuals aged 10 through 25 years

title: Blujepa (gepotidacin) approved by US FDA for uncomplicated urinary tract infections
evidence: Blujepa is the first in a new class of oral antibiotics for uUTIs in nearly 30 years

title: Bepirovirsen accepted for FDA priority review with Breakthrough Therapy Designation
evidence: NDA accepted for priority review, granted Breakthrough Therapy Designation; PDUFA goal date October 26, 2026

title: Bepirovirsen accepted for regulatory review in China as potential functional cure for hepatitis B
evidence: Accepted for regulatory review in China as a potential first-in-class functional cure for chronic hepatitis B; granted Breakthrough Therapy designation

title: Bepirovirsen achieves unprecedented functional cure rates in phase III B-Well trials
evidence: 19% functional cure in the overall study population and 26% in patients with lower viral activity compared to 0% with standard of care only

title: ViiV presents data for next generation of ultra long-acting HIV treatments (VH184, VH499)
evidence: VH499 capsid inhibitor supports potential for ultra long-acting twice-yearly dosing; VH184 first third-generation INSTI in development

title: Luke Miels appointed CEO designate, succeeding Emma Walmsley
evidence: Luke Miels assumes CEO role 1 January 2026; Emma Walmsley steps down from Board 31 December 2025, employment ends 30 September 2026

title: Roy Jakobs joins GSK Board as Non-Executive Director
evidence: Roy Jakobs, CEO of Royal Philips, joined the GSK Board as a Non-Executive Director from 13 July 2026

title: GSK licenses Noetik AI foundation models for oncology in $50m collaboration
evidence: $50 million upfront five-year deal for Noetik OCTO-VC virtual cell models in NSCLC and colorectal cancer, trained on ~40 million cells

title: GSK to invest $30 billion in US R&D and manufacturing over five years
evidence: Invest at least $30 billion in the United States over the next 5 years; includes $1.2bn new biologics flex factory at Upper Merion, Pennsylvania

title: GSK and Zhifei revise and extend strategic vaccine collaboration in China
evidence: Zhifei exclusive rights for Shingrix in mainland China extended through 2034; potential total value to GSK £2.3bn over 2024-2029

title: Nucala COPD launch and HIV medicines drive Q2 2026 Specialty growth
evidence: Specialty Medicines +14% led by continued launch of Nucala in COPD and HIV medicines Cabenuva and Dovato

title: Vaccines growth in Q2 2026 aided by international Arexvy and Shingrix expansion
evidence: Vaccines sales rose 8%, helped by international expansion of Arexvy, meningitis vaccines and Shingrix in Europe

title: GSK Zantac settlement resolves ~80,000 US state court cases for up to $2.2bn
evidence: GSK will make an aggregate payment of up to $2.2 billion to resolve all U.S. state court product liability cases, with no admission of liability
